accessibility.description: The iOS game supports VoiceOver, and blind players report sustained play of its military strategy and alliance systems. Some actionable text is not identified as a button. Older reports describe inaccessible sound/profile settings and anti-bot checks that required sighted or developer assistance; later players report improvements, but those limitations have not been independently retested.
